title: Klaviyo pricing - Active profile tiered, starting at $20/month
clean_text: Klaviyo's Email plan starts at $20 per month for 500 contacts and 5,000 emails. The combined Email + SMS plan starts at $35 per month for 251 to 500 active profiles, including 5,000+ monthly email sends and 1,250 SMS or MMS credits, with product recommendations included at this entry tier. Pricing scales with active profile count: 10,000 contacts costs approximately $150 per month, and 20,000 contacts costs approximately $375 per month. SMS and WhatsApp messaging draw from a separate shared credit pool billed by message volume.
